# Exit Codes

<!-- GENERATED by `jit::schema::render_exit_code_reference` (`crates/jit/src/schema.rs`). Do not edit by hand; regenerate instead. -->

`jit` defines a small, stable set of process exit codes so scripts and agents can branch on outcomes without parsing output. This page is projected from the exit-code taxonomy and the command mappings in `jit --schema`. Each emitted mapping is bound by a test to the runtime that produces it: the shared classifier (`classify` in `crates/jit/src/output/failure.rs`) for codes raised as typed errors, and the findings envelope a completed run reports (the findings signals). See [CLI JSON contracts](cli-commands.md#cli-json-contracts) for output and child-process passthrough behavior.

## Global taxonomy

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `0` | Command succeeded |
| `1` | Generic error occurred |
| `2` | Invalid arguments or usage error |
| `3` | Resource not found (issue, gate, etc.) |
| `4` | Validation failed (cycle detected, broken references, etc.) |
| `5` | Permission denied |
| `6` | Resource already exists |
| `10` | External dependency failed (git, file system, etc.) |
| `11` | A lock wait expired while another jit process held the lock; retrying may succeed |
| `141` | Downstream reader closed the pipe while jit was writing (128 + SIGPIPE) |

## Command-specific mappings

Most commands draw only from the global taxonomy above. The rows below identify the codes a specific command family emits, derived from the codes each command's handler registration declares. An **exception** is a code a completed run emits to signal findings (for example, `doc check-links` exits `4` for broken links), or the broken-pipe status. `*` marks a code every command can reach: `0` on successful completion, and the failure codes through the shared classifier.

| Command | Code | Condition | Exception |
|---------|------|-----------|-----------|
| `*` | `0` | Command completed successfully. |  |
| `*` | `1` | No typed classifier matched the failure (generic error), or input data could not be parsed. |  |
| `*` | `2` | Invalid arguments or usage error, including an unresolvable, ambiguous, or too-short id prefix. |  |
| `*` | `3` | A referenced issue, gate, gate-run, preset, lease, repository, or file path was not found. |  |
| `*` | `5` | A filesystem operation was denied. |  |
| `*` | `10` | The repository's on-disk format is not the one this binary accepts, or a filesystem/subprocess I/O operation failed. |  |
| `*` | `11` | A lock wait expired while another jit process held the lock (`JIT_LOCK_TIMEOUT`); the command changed nothing and may be retried. |  |
| `*` | `141` | A downstream reader closed the pipe while jit was still writing. | yes |
| `apply` | `4` | The dependency would create a cycle. |  |
| `claim acquire, claim release, claim renew, claim heartbeat, claim status, claim list, claim force-evict, hooks install, worktree list` | `10` | The command requires Git. |  |
| `config validate` | `4` | The repo or environment-variable configuration failed to load or carried an invalid value. | yes |
| `dep add` | `4` | The dependency would create a cycle. Repository or domain validation failed. |  |
| `doc check-links` | `4` | One or more documents have broken links. Documents with only risky-link warnings exit `0`: warnings are reported, never fatal. | yes |
| `gate define, profile pack, snapshot export` | `6` | The requested resource already exists. |  |
| `gate preset apply` | `3` | One or more preset targets failed; the findings report retains successful targets and per-target errors. | yes |
| `gate status-all` | `4` | One or more required gates have not passed. | yes |
| `gate evaluate, gate evaluate-all` | `4` | A quality-gate checker did not pass. |  |
| `gate evaluate-many` | `2` | The first failing target determines the classified code and status; the findings report retains every target's result. | yes |
| `gate evaluate-many` | `3` | The first failing target determines the classified code and status; the findings report retains every target's result. | yes |
| `gate evaluate-many` | `4` | The first failing target determines the classified code and status; the findings report retains every target's result. | yes |
| `gate evaluate-many` | `1` | The first failing target determines the classified code and status; the findings report retains every target's result. | yes |
| `gate evaluate-many` | `10` | The first failing target determines the classified code and status; the findings report retains every target's result. | yes |
| `gate evaluate-many` | `5` | The first failing target determines the classified code and status; the findings report retains every target's result. | yes |
| `gate evaluate-many` | `11` | The first failing target determines the classified code and status; the findings report retains every target's result. | yes |
| `invariant check` | `4` | Enforcement drift was found (declared enforcement not backed by an enforcing rule). | yes |
| `profile diff` | `4` | The difference report found targets or final validation that prevent publication. | yes |
| `profile apply` | `4` | Profile planning found packages being applied that define one target or declaration differently. A profile application would overwrite paths that differ from HEAD; committing or discarding those changes lets it proceed. |  |
| `profile add` | `4` | Profile planning found packages being applied that define one target or declaration differently. |  |
| `issue create` | `4` | Repository or domain validation failed. |  |
| `issue update, issue claim, issue claim-next` | `4` | Unfinished dependencies block the operation. Repository or domain validation failed. |  |
| `issue delete` | `2` | Issue deletion lacks the required operator confirmation. |  |
| `search` | `1` | The external ripgrep search tool was not found. The search backend failed while executing a query. |  |
| `serve` | `1` | The foreground server process exited with a failure status. |  |
| `validate` | `4` | Repository, scope, issue, selected-rule, or explanation validation reported error-severity findings, or a `--branch-drift` or `--leases` check failed or could not run. | yes |
